incumbent.name: Jeff Sinkovics
incumbent.summary: Miami County's website lists Jeff Sinkovics (R) as Prosecuting Attorney {miami_officials}. He is not one of the two nominees on the 2026 general-election ballot {in_list}, so the seat appears to be open; no source fetched for this profile explains why he is not running.
record: May 3, 2022: Unopposed in the Republican primary for Prosecuting Attorney of the 51st Circuit with 2,183 votes; no Democratic candidate filed {miami_2022_primary}.

The county describes the office as enforcing the Indiana Criminal Code and handling child support orders, with a victim advocate who helps victims navigate the court system and seek restitution, and deferral programs for traffic tickets {miami_prosecutor_page}.

race_context: Miami County (Peru) makes up Indiana's 51st Judicial Circuit. Two candidates are on the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot: Democrat Bryce J. Runkle and Republican Courtney B. Alwine {in_list}.

Neither candidate is the current prosecutor; the county lists Jeff Sinkovics in that office {miami_officials}, and Alwine is listed in the county directory as a deputy prosecuting attorney in his office {miami_directory_alwine}.
In the 2022 cycle the incumbent ran unopposed in the primary and no Democrat filed {miami_2022_primary}; 2026 is a contested general election {in_list}.

Local coverage of this race could not be read for this profile: the Kokomo Tribune's May 8, 2026 primary results story showed its results section in scrambled (subscriber-only) form, and other local coverage was behind a subscription wall. No forums, debates, candidate websites or campaign statements were found.
